messages:
Harper (Ops): Quick follow-up from the outage — we need a tight owner map for external comms, a list of RCA action owners + due dates, and a check for recurring patterns. Who can take which piece?
Diego (SRE): I'll take the internal RCA and ticketize actions. Draft RCA in 48h, final in 96h. Will pull historical incidents for pattern analysis.
Rina (Support): Support needs a 2-sentence customer FAQ and canned replies within 12h. Also need guidance on which customers should receive the private packet vs public summary (enterprise vs public customers).
Ellen (Legal): Public language should be non-speculative and confirm impact/restoration/data exposure only. Private RCAs can be shared under NDA or contract provisions. I can pre-approve templates.
Sam (Product): For status page copy, keep it short: impact, restore window, data statement, and ETA for a follow-up. Suggest wording below — feel free to edit.
Harper (Ops): Paste suggested status page copy and a one-paragraph external summary here. Rina will use the one-paragraph for canned replies.
Sam (Product): Draft status blurb:
```
Service disruption: Text-generation experienced degraded performance from 16:04 to 16:47 UTC. Service is restored. No customer data was exposed. We are investigating the cause and will provide a detailed update within 72 hours.
```
Sam (Product): One-paragraph external summary (for customers):
"We experienced degraded text-generation service between 16:04 and 16:47 UTC, which caused increased latency and occasional errors for a subset of requests. Our engineers restored service and are investigating the underlying cause; no customer data was exposed. We will publish a detailed update within 72 hours and make remediation plans public where appropriate."
Rina (Support): That works. I'll build canned replies and an escalation snippet for enterprise customers requesting the private packet. ETA 12h.
Diego (SRE): On recurrence: I'll flag prior incidents with autoscaling/concurrency symptoms and include a small table in the RCA appendix. If we see a pattern, propose a targeted resilience workstream and priority.
Ellen (Legal): I'll review the one-paragraph and canned replies once Rina posts them. For request handling, route RCAs through Support so we have a paper trail.
Harper (Ops): Action item tracker (in-thread):
- SAM: post status page blurb after Ellen OKs (due 2h)
- RINA: canned replies + escalation snippet (due 12h)
- DIEGO: RCA draft + ticketized actions (draft 48h, final 96h); attach historical incidents (24h)
- ELLEN: legal sign-off for external summary and private packet template (24h)
Harper (Ops): We'll run a 30-min sync tomorrow 10:30 UTC to review RCA draft and verify ticket owners. Please add JIRA links to this thread once tickets are created.
IncidentBot: Incident #2026-256 marked RESOLVED by automated runbook.
Diego (SRE): I'll include SLO impact metrics (p50/p95, error rate delta, requests/sec) in the RCA so we can triage based on customer-experienced impact.
Rina (Support): Noted — I'll prepare targeted messages for customers with higher request volumes.
Harper (Ops): Thanks all. Keep updates in this thread — single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
